creator: Alexander Terp
description:
src/terminal/title.rs:1 strips one leading glyph from braille or ·✢✳✶✻✽. Claude Code now spins ◐◑ (U+25D0/25D1), so every frame changes terminal_title_stripped, bumps revision, and emits pane_updated: 40 alternating '◐ task'/'◑ task' writes produced 40 events, where ✳/✶ produced 1. On a live daemon with three agents working: 329 pane_updated in 60 s, 314 of them title-only. The 512-event replay buffer then holds about a minute of spinner frames, and six such agents would saturate the one-event-per-kind-per-100 ms cap, delaying real pane_updated changes.

Muster strips by Unicode block in its adapter since 2026-09-24 (crates/muster-herdr/src/title.rs), so this is an upstream ask, not a Muster bug. Suggest herdr strip by block too (Braille, Geometric Shapes, Dingbats) rather than a list. Evidence: docs/observations/herdr-0.8.0.md section 26.
title: 🔌 Upstream: herdr's title stripping misses Claude Code's ◐◑ spinner
